subject: general
question: Which of the following statements **accurately **identifies the venue and complete schedule of the Yonex-Sunrise India Open 2025, classified as a BWF Super 750 badminton tournament?

options.text: It was conducted at Thyagaraj Stadium, New Delhi, from January 10 to 15, 2025, as part of the BWF World Tour.
The event took place at the Siri Fort Sports Complex, New Delhi, from January 12 to 17, 2025, under the BWF Super Series framework.
It was hosted at the K.D. Jadhav Indoor Hall, IG Stadium, New Delhi, from January 14 to 19, 2025, as part of the BWF Super 750 tier.
It was organized at Talkatora Indoor Stadium, New Delhi, from January 16 to 21, 2025, under the India Badminton Circuit calendar.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It was hosted at the K.D. Jadhav Indoor Hall, IG Stadium, New Delhi, from January 14 to 19, 2025, as part of the BWF Super 750 tier.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Yonex-Sunrise India Open 2025 is classified as a **BWF Super 750 tournament**, which is part of the prestigious BWF World Tour.
 
• The tournament was hosted at the **K.D. Jadhav Indoor Hall**, located within IG Stadium, New Delhi.
 
• The event's official schedule spanned from **January 14 to 19, 2025**, showcasing top international badminton players.
 
• The BWF Super 750 tier is among the highest levels in the badminton tournament hierarchy, second only to Super 1000 tournaments.
 
• This tournament attracts global participants and offers significant ranking points and prize money, contributing to its importance in the badminton calendar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Yonex-Sunrise India Open**

 
 
• The Yonex-Sunrise India Open is an annual badminton tournament held in India, featuring international players competing in singles and doubles categories.
 
• It forms part of the BWF World Tour and is classified under different tiers based on prize money and ranking points.
 
• The tournament plays a vital role in promoting badminton in India and fostering global competitive standards.
